name: Lantadilla (Spain)
description: Square flag horizontally divided crimson over blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Lantadilla (a castle and a lion on red and white, and a bridge on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Lantadilla; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Lantadilla arms — castle and lion on red and white, and bridge on blue
